WITH patient_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
        AVG(l.HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(l.HCT), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        avg_wbc,
        ratio,
        AVG(ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
    FROM patient_stats
)
SELECT
    ID AS patient_id,
    SEX AS sex,
    avg_wbc AS average_wbc,
    ratio,
    ratio - overall_mean_ratio AS ratio_minus_overall_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE ratio > overall_mean_ratio
ORDER BY ratio_minus_overall_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each patient’s averages use all matching laboratory records; AVG ignores missing values, and a zero average HCT yields a missing ratio. The overall mean includes all patients with a nonmissing ratio.
